entries.source: Sean: feedback from last night playtest
entries.status: Prototype 28 mechanics integrated and headless-tested; directional hero art and live review pending
entries.directional_fire: Heroes aim left/right/up/diagonally; airborne down+fire shoots straight down, unless weapon prohibits direction.
entries.weapon_policy: Each weapon must explicitly declare aiming permissions. Starting ranged weapons permit eight-way airborne aiming; do not assume every melee/special supports it.
entries.flushfiend_entrances: Trigger offscreen walk-ins rather than visible blink-spawns.

entries.source: Sean: weapon snaps forward between diagonal shots
entries.requirement: Show aim continuously without firing; releasing fire while holding direction must preserve visible aim. Keep existing horizontal fallback when aim input is released.

entries.source: Sean: visible aiming still broken; pause menu needs main-menu option
entries.status: Engineering asked to prioritize implementation, verification and fresh export
requirements: Verify and fix visible aiming without firing for both heroes; prior handoff is not confirmed delivered.
Add visible selectable Return to Main Menu in pause, supporting keyboard/controller and mouse; existing shortcut alone is insufficient.
entries.delivery_owner: Engineering; owns runtime/build/roadmap updates during integration

entries.source: Sean: Flushfiends reverse instantly when jumped over
entries.requirement: Brake, stop and turn for approximately one second before reverse pursuit; retain persistent aggro.

entries.source: Sean: running horizontal plunger shots pass over Flushfiends; standing shots hit
entries.status: Fixed and exported in Prototype 38; packaged tests passed; live playtest pending
entries.requirement: On level ground, Sean horizontal shots must connect with reachable Flushfiends consistently across every running frame and both facing directions, as they do while idle.
entries.suspected_cause: Run body attachment offsets affect both rendered weapon and muzzle in scripts/hero_aim_art.gd.selected_pose; measure against enemy hitbox before choosing fix.
entries.acceptance: Regression checks for idle and every run frame, left/right, enemy hop phases, muzzle alignment, solid occlusion and existing range. Keep visible barrel and projectile origin aligned; do not disguise issue by changing weapon damage or arbitrary oversized hitboxes.
entries.confirmed_cause: Run muzzle rises above enemy centerline collision bounds; visible projectile thickness was ignored.
entries.fix: Sweep the rendered transverse half-width (Sean 7 px, Tony 2 px) against enemies and solids. Art approved preserving existing sprite registration. No muzzle shift, damage or range change.
entries.validation: 504 frame/facing/distance/hop geometry cases, 24 real combat hits, existing aiming/range/animation tests pass. High airborne targets can legitimately clear horizontal fire.
